title: The Man Who Knew It Was Raining

lines.text: Three suspects. Three alibis. But one of them is impossible. Can you spot it before the detective does?
My diamond necklace is gone! The power went out at exactly nine o'clock!
Nobody leaves this mansion. Now, where was each of you at nine?
In the kitchen, sir, cooking dinner. Lightning lit up the kitchen window, then everything went dark.
Down in the basement, fixing a leaky pipe. I saw the lightning flash through the basement window.
Upstairs in the laundry room. The thunder rattled the window so hard, I dropped the sheets.
Hmm. Let me see these rooms for myself.
Thank you. I know exactly who is lying.
Kitchen. Basement. Laundry room. One of these stories does not fit the house.
